ORAL ORDER In Crl.P.No.7327/2024 & Crl.P.No.7567/2024:
Learned Senior counsel, Sri. P.P. Hegde appearing for the petitioners seeks leave of this Court to withdraw these petitions.
Placing the said submission on record, these petitions are disposed as withdrawn.

In W.P.No.17939/2021:
The petitioners are before this Court calling in question the proceedings in C.C.No.12953/2021 registered for offences punishable under Sections 498A, 307,
506, 323 of the IPC and under Sections 3 and 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961.
2.

Heard learned Senior counsel, Sri. P.P. Hegde along with learned counsel, Sri. Venkatesh Somareddy appearing for the petitioners, Sri. Jagadeesha B.N., learned Addl.SPP appearing for respondent No.1, Sri. Kamaluddin Ahmad, learned counsel appearing for respondent No.2 and have perused the material on record.
NC: 2024:KHC:41141 3.
The petitioners during the pendency of the proceedings, they have settled the dispute by drawing up certain terms of settlement.

The application filed under Section 320 of the Cr.P.C. seeking compounding of the offence reads as follows:
"APPLICATION UNDER SECTION 320 READ WITH SECTOIN 482 OF CODE OF CRIMINAL PROCEDURE, 1973 Petitioner and the Respondent submits as follows:
1. Above writ petition is filed by the Petitioner to quash the criminal case in C.C No.
12953/2021 (arising out of Crime No.58 of 2021) pending on the file of VI Additional Chief Metropolitan Magistrate, Bengaluru for the offences punishable under Sections 498(A), 307, 506, 323 of IPC and Section 3 and 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act.
2. Petitioner and the Respondent got married on 25- 07-2018 and have no children.
3. Parties have settled the dispute among themselves before the Bangalore Mediation Centre in M.C No.5911/2021 as per the terms and conditions mentioned here below.
a. Both Petitioner and Respondent agree that they do not have any claims over the movable or immovable assets belonging to each other.
b. Both parties hereby declare that they shall have no claim of any nature whatsoever against each other either present past or future.
